# awrelay

> Portable agent messaging — findings, alerts, coordination.

One agent's transcript is invisible to every other agent, so a conclusion reached once gets re-derived by the next session that hits the same symptom.

## Install

```
pip install awrelay
```

## In Claude Code

- mcp: `awrelay mcp`
- hook: `awrelay inbox --claude-hook --direct-only` (on UserPromptSubmit)

## Use it in 30 seconds

Have one agent post a finding to a channel a human can also read.

## Composes with

- [awgit](https://aitherium.github.io/awgit/) — Semantic version control on top of git — edit-ops and leases.
- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awdelphi](https://aitherium.github.io/awdelphi/) — Anonymous multi-round expert panels — a converged answer with a trace.
